entries.name: chest-full

args.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: registered chest treasure state for a dark pixel-art dungeon crawler. Image1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET, the existing OPEN supply chest master; image2 is its native128px runtime style/registration reference. Change ONLY the contents INSIDE the open lower box: remove the amber medicine bottle and folded dressing completely, replace them with a low, clearly visible heap of worn ochre GOLD COINS and a few simple red/green loose stones partly sunk among the coins. No glowing treasure, light rays or glitter. KEEP THE ENTIRE CHEST PIXELS/SHAPE/POSE/CAMERA/SCALE in EXACTLY the same positions: lower box, lid outline and angle, boards, iron straps, rusty hardware, hinges, legs and foot contact. Contents must stay behind the front board and inside the box, never spill onto the floor or outside chest silhouette. Same restrained chunky pixel art, neutral wood/iron shading. Genuine transparent background outside the chest. No shadow slab, environment, text, borders, bottles, fabric or added ornament. This must swap with the supplied closed/empty chest without any visual jump.

reference_roles: edit target: original supply chest master
